affiliation.department: Department of Humanities, Social and Political Sciences (D-GESS)

research_focus.title: Urban Resilience & Nature-Based Solutions (NBS)
research_focus.description: High-resolution spatial modeling, remote sensing, and decision support tools for climate adaptation, urban greenness equity (greenR), and exploring adaptive pathways under climate uncertainty (Adaptive Multifutures Framework).

research_focus.title: Environmental Sensing & Spatio-Temporal Modeling
research_focus.description: Designing distributed IoT sensor networks, trust-based dynamic calibration algorithms, anomaly detection pipelines (ADF), and crowd-sourced environmental analytics (VAYU, exploreR, AirBox, UpStream).

research_focus.title: AI for Environment, Citizen Feedback & Moderation
research_focus.description: Developing participatory AI accountability tools (CitizenVoice) to analyze, summarize, and moderate citizen input in public consultations, safeguarding minority viewpoints and mitigating algorithmic bias.

research_focus.title: Responsible Technology Design & Value-Sensitive Design (VSD)
research_focus.description: Frameworks for ethical smart cities, participatory resilience, digital democracy, and agent-based modeling of collective intelligence and socio-technical transitions.

grants.title: CArE-Cities: Clean Air Engineering for Cities

appointments.description: Leading research on urban resilience, spatial modeling, and participatory AI governance. Developing open-source tools (greenR, CitizenVoice) and co-managing an ERC Advanced Grant on participatory governance and digital democracy.
Conducted research on ERC Advanced Grant CoCi (Co-Evolving City Life). Developed Routify (multi-criteria environmental routing) and served as Co-Investigator on ESRC/MOST UpStream project.
ERC Citizen Sense / AirKit project with Prof. Jennifer Gabrys. Co-developed and deployed community-driven air quality sensing toolkits across European and UK deployments.

appointments.department: Global Centre for Clean Air Research (GCARE)
appointments.description: EU Horizon 2020 iSCAPE project. Led co-creation studies and citizen-science air pollution monitoring campaigns across European cities.
Researched participatory sensing, sensor calibration, and anomaly detection algorithms for the AirBox PM2.5 sensor network under Prof. Ling-Jyh Chen.
